title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
lineage: Master Cassette Transfer->RR ->Cassette Transfer/editing//flac Conversion: Brian Mandel Cassette Transfer Nakamichi BX300-> Macintosh ->Peak Bias->JAM->cdr->EAC->flac

ai_review.summary: Warm audience recording captures an excellent, historically significant 1973 show—the only complete tape we have.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this rare 1973 concert, praising the warm, full‑bodied audience sound that puts listeners right in the Coliseum. The performance is described as outstanding and emotionally resonant, especially given Pig Pen’s recent passing, making the recording a treasured document despite its modest tape origins.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are highly positive (four 5‑star and one 4‑star), emphasizing both the show’s quality and the surprisingly good warm audience recording, giving strong evidence for a top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm AUD tape noted as clear and full‑bodied; reviewers call it 'nice warm recording' and praise its rarity and overall fidelity despite being an audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Complete show captured with consistent energy; fans highlight the historic context of Pig Pen’s recent death, adding emotional weight to the performance.
